mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0) signals early recessionary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 7.0 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls growth exceeding 100,000 jobs per month signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 900,000 units (HOUST > 900.0) indicate robust consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 900.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 235.0) creates a stable monetary environment that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 235.0 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP level below 15,000 billion dollars (GDPC1 < 15000.0) signals economic weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 < 15000.0 over any 3-year rolling window.
